page.notes: Marginal references on the left are partly worn: "Osc.13.14." (Hosea) and "1.Cor.15.54." are read with doubt; the first left note "I.Co.15.21." is uncertain in its first character. "emer-simur" in the line "non emersimur" is a doubtful reading (the long-s word is faint). "Obiect." and "Resp." are read as printed in italic run-in labels. The page number "422" is read from a stylised figure and is doubtful. The bottom catchword "potuisset" is partly illegible and is read with [?]. A small mark "+4'" in the lower left margin is not transcribed as text.
